responsibility: Provides the core compile-time target definition header for the LM32 port. It establishes architectural properties and ABI macros such as endianness, word and type sizes, register numbers and classes, calling convention and stack layout constants, PIC and small-data behavior, builtin preprocessor defines, assembler output conventions, section selection, symbol formatting, alignment rules, and miscellaneous target costs and modes. This header is the central specification that parameterizes generic GCC code for LM32 before dynamic hook logic in lm32.cc is consulted.
same_name_distinction: Provides the static target specification layer for LM32 as preprocessor macros and constants: register numbers/classes, storage layout, ABI/assembler conventions, PIC and small-data macros, and builtins/spec strings. Unlike lm32.cc it does not implement hook bodies, unlike lm32.md it does not encode RTL patterns, and unlike lm32.opt it does not declare the user-selectable -m options themselves.
